posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Any of them really. Team Tachy will allow other heroes to draw lots of cards, while being able to shut down damage, and getting rid of pesky ongoings and environment cards. NightMist will be able to blast everything into oblivion if anything happens to get too nasty, dispatch lots of ongoings and environment cards, and tanking damage dealt to the highest. Engine Bunker can also get rid of ongoings, deal out lots of damage, and even shut down the enviroment deck.

 

So it really gets down to who you feel like playing!

posts.name: Pydro

WOW! That was really concise and helpful. Let's see if you can do that again: AZ, Wraith, Legacy. GO!

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Absolute Zero is a heavy single damage dealer while doing light spread attacks aswell, he has limited ongoing destruction but he can destroy up to 3 (the most that can be destroyed not including the randomness of Planar Banashment) at once and deal damage to all targets because of it, he's also a very good tank and can still deal out damage while tanking if he has Cold Snap and/or Impale. Wraith... Gosh, it'd be easier to say what Wraith can't do. After all she can deal tons of damage, control the villain deck, save the hero with the lowest health, lower damage dealt by the villain, destroy ongoing/environment cards, and can even tank for a short period of time. Legacy can boost the other heroes thus making them ever better, tank damage, and deal a fair amount of damage while healing his allies.

 

I have considered writing up my own guides, but haven't gotten around to it. Also Flamethrower has done such a good job on most them that I don't really feel the need to. The only one I wasn't really a fan of is his Absolute Zero one.
